description: Harmonised Traffic Counts (full and snapshot release) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (DITRDCSA). Members: Harmonised Traffic Counts; Harmonised Traffic Counts (snapshot release). Example entry: The Harmonised Traffic Counts dataset reports on the number and type of vehicles travelling past traffic counter stations across Australia in a given duration, over time. Depending on the sophistication of the counter and the provider, counts can be by vehicle classification (using the Austroads 1-12 classification ), a 2 or 4-level grouping of the 12-level classification or a simple count of all traffic. Coverage is Australia, 2006 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as weekly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-12-19. Files and pages listed: API, CSV, PDF (10 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
